第71章 华语乐坛的“冰桶挑战”-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“你说什么？《金大班》男主角？”

接到电话的魏老板一愣。

他没想到这位刚挖过来的经纪人，给自己介绍的第一份片约居然是这个？！

“是啊，老板。”

到现在为止，杨天真还有些懵。

我就辞个职，怎么还带过来一个片约？

在她印象中，范兵兵这个人处事圆滑，八面玲珑，却绝不是好欺负的人。

魏沐也纳闷，他这边刚挖了对方工作室得力干将，后者转投就邀请他出演男一号。

这是什么意思，范兵兵馋我身子？

他对《金大班》没什么印象，当时追这部剧光顾着看范小胖的旗袍装，其他没注意。

就像几年后的大烂片《富春山居图》，谁看完还记得剧情啊，全奔着黑泽志玲变装秀去的！！

“天真，你怎么看？”

电话那头沉默一会，然后回道：“老板，《金大班》这部剧投资不低，至少3000万以上，还是男一号，我觉得你可以考虑一下。”

“片酬多少？”

“打包价100万。”

目前魏沐这边的片酬为5万/集，但是男主角在这部剧的戏份不算多，只有20集左右。

“好。”

挂断电话，陷入沉思。

他在仙剑三饰演的是徐长卿，男二号，而《金大班》那边是男一号，还是搭档范兵兵。

范兵兵这个女人别的不说，流量管够。

到时候再炒一波绯闻，那他的人气会来到另一个高度.....

想了想，没有立刻答复，他还要考虑一下。

9月，《仙剑三》剧组进入忙碌状态。

这部剧的拍摄周期为4个月，4个月给一般剧组足够拍完。

可《仙剑三》是仙侠剧，涉及100多个主要场景，包括蜀山、锁妖塔、古藤林、海底城等大型奇幻场景。

场景多，意味着转场多，转场意味着耗时间。

作为剧组男二号，徐长卿的戏份本就多，再加上老蔡和导演给他加了不少戏，导致魏沐压根抽不开身，一些歌曲奖项只能拜托朋友代领。

在这种情况下，《鲁豫有约—画皮》播出。

..........

锡市，作为苏省十三太保，其近些年发展不错。

“太湖三傻”不是开玩笑的，而且人家还有机场！！

林筱毕业以后跟着男朋友回到锡市，找了份文员工作。

文员的工资不高，好在她和男友都是锡市本地人，省去一笔租房开销。

俩人盘算着过年去见对方父母，然后明年找个黄道吉日结婚。

"What did you say? The male protagonist of "Jin Tai Ban"?"

Boss Wei was stunned when he received the call.

He didn't expect that the first film contract this newly recruited agent would introduce to him would be this?!

"Yes, boss."

Until now, Yang Tianzhen is still a little confused.

I just resigned from my job, why did I get a film appointment?

In her impression, Fan Bingbing was smooth and well-rounded, but he was by no means someone easy to bully.

Wei Mu was also puzzled. He had just poached a capable person from the other studio, and the latter switched companies and invited him to play the male lead.

What does this mean, Fan Bingbing is greedy for my body?

He had no impression of "Jin Tai Ban". At that time, he only watched Fan Xiaopang's cheongsam outfit while following the show, but didn't pay attention to anything else.

Just like the bad movie "Residence in Fuchun Mountain" a few years later, who still remembers the plot after watching it? They all went to Kurosawa Chirei's drag show!!

"Innocent, what do you think?"

There was silence on the other end of the phone for a while, and then he replied: "Boss, the investment in the drama "Jin Tai Ban" is not low, at least 30 million, and it is the male lead. I think you can consider it."

"How much is the salary?"

"The package price is 1 million."

Wei Mu's current salary is 50,000 yuan/episode, but the actor's role in this drama is not much, only about 20 episodes.

"Okay."

Hang up the phone and fall into deep thought.

He played Xu Changqing, the second male lead, in Sword and Sword 3, while he played the first male lead in "Jin Tai Ban" and his partner Fan Bingbing.

If nothing else, this woman, Fan Bingbing, has enough traffic.

When the time comes and there is another wave of scandals, his popularity will reach another level...

After thinking about it, he didn't reply immediately. He still had to think about it.

In September, the crew of "Sword and Sword III" entered a busy state.

The filming cycle of this drama is 4 months, which is enough for an ordinary crew to complete the filming.

But "Sword and Sword III" is a fairy tale drama, involving more than 100 main scenes, including large fantasy scenes such as Shu Mountain, Demon Locking Tower, Ancient Vine Forest, and Underwater City.

Many scenes mean many transitions, and transitions mean time-consuming.

As the second male lead in the crew, Xu Changqing already had a lot of roles. In addition, Lao Cai and the director added a lot of scenes to him, which made Wei Mu unable to get away at all, and he had to ask his friends to receive some song awards on his behalf.

In this case, "A Date with Luyu - Painted Skin" was broadcast.

...........

Xishi, as one of the Thirteenth Taibao in Jiangsu Province, has developed well in recent years.

The "Three Idiots of Taihu" are no joke, and they also have an airport!!

After Lin Xiao graduated, she followed her boyfriend back to Xishi and found a clerk's job.

The clerk's salary is not high, but fortunately she and her boyfriend are both locals from Xishi, which saves them a lot of rent.

The two planned to meet each other's parents during the Chinese New Year, and then find an auspicious day to get married next year.
